dedupe_keys.name: hydraulic model hec ras of the upper san saba river between fort mckavett and menard tx

description: Aubrey Harris and colleagues publish a two-dimensional HEC-RAS model covering the Upper San Saba River between Fort McKavett and Menard, Texas. Terrain combines 2018 USGS 3DEP elevation with field-surveyed underwater cross-sections, and calibration used measured water surfaces and velocities. The September 2023 Zenodo deposit provides Model.zip, a methods document and README free under CC0. The README specifies HEC-RAS 6.2 or later and lists terrain and land-cover TIFF/HDF files, hydrographs, geometry, plans, initial conditions and DSS time-series outputs. Steady low-flow runs supply starting water surfaces for unsteady simulations. The model can support hydraulic scenario comparisons for this river reach. Exact computational-cell size, calibration metrics and simulated event dates remain unknown from the inspected metadata. Related catalogue record model-hec-ras supplies the required modelling software, not this particular configured river model. The archive was not downloaded or executed.
